text:
Maya (CS): Heads up — ~12 EU trial onboard attempts started failing at 09:10 UTC with webhook auth errors. I'm drafting an outbound note but need an engineering blurb and mitigation summary to include. Affected tenants listed in internal sheet. @Ravi can you confirm root cause? @Liam please prep a short customer-friendly status. :eyes:

Ravi (Eng): Quick update from logs: x509: certificate has expired on the EU onboarding connector. Looks like our automated cert renewal job failed for that cluster. This caused webhooks to be rejected (401/403). I'm deploying a renewed cert + restart now. ETA ~25m for rollout and initial replay kick-off.

Priya (Ops): I've opened an infra ticket and prepped a rollback/playbook. Also enabling temporary fallback ingress to accept retries from providers while connector restarts. I can toggle it live — doing so in 2m.

Liam (CS): On the comms front I'll draft a concise status update for affected customers and a tailored note for accounts flagged as renewal-risk. Can someone drop a one-line RCA we can paste verbatim?

Ravi (Eng): One-line RCA for customers: "Root cause: an automated certificate renewal job failed for the EU onboarding connector, causing webhook authentication failures (expired cert)."

Deploy Bot: deploy started by r-ops:connector-restart at 09:22 UTC; status: success.

Maya (CS): Patch + restart confirmed by ops. @Ravi are replays queued? Do we have a list of tenants still failing? @Elena reported their onboarding still shows 502 in the console.

Ravi (Eng): Starting replay of queued webhook events for the affected tenants now. Backlog size ~150 events across 12 tenants, estimate 12–18 minutes to complete. Will post progress.

Elena (Customer Success - Tenant): Thanks — can you confirm whether customers need to re-send anything, or will you replay automatically? Also timeline question for trial customers who were blocked during the signup flow.

Maya (CS): Reply we plan to send: No action required from customers. We will automatically replay missed webhook events for up to 48 hours of activity and prioritize trial sign-ups. We'll follow up when replay completes. Offering affected accounts a goodwill credit (1 week) plus a scheduled onboarding session. Draft to send:

```
Hi — we experienced a short interruption to EU onboarding between 09:10–09:30 UTC due to an expired certificate on our onboarding connector. Our team has renewed the certificate, restarted the connector, and is replaying missed webhook events for affected tenants. No action is required on your side; we will confirm when processing is complete. As an apology, we are offering a one-week credit and an onboarding session — please reply if you'd like to schedule.
```

Liam (CS): I'll send that to the affected list in 10m and tag account leads for renewal-risk customers. I'll paste the sent copy here.

Priya (Ops): Added label onboard-cert-expiry to the incident tracker and scheduled a postmortem. Owner: Ravi. Postmortem goals: why renewal job failed, why no alert at T-7d, and automation coverage. Also adding an alert for cert age at T-7d and T-1d.

Ravi (Eng): Will own the postmortem. Immediate follow-ups: (1) fix renewal job and add unit/integration tests, (2) add alert + dashboard for cert expiry windows, (3) verify rotation across EU clusters. Filing PRs today.

Maya (CS): Thanks team. Final asks: @Liam share the outbound message copy and affected list here after send; @Priya please confirm credits issued and booking link for onboarding session; @Ravi share the postmortem link when ready so I can include a short summary to customers. :thumbsup:

Liam (CS): Will do — sending now.

Ravi (Eng): Replay complete for all 12 tenants at 09:38 UTC. Replayed 150 events. Monitoring for errors for the next hour.

Maya (CS): Marking thread resolved once customer confirmations are out. I'll close the loop with the account team and update renewal trackers. Thanks everyone.
